provider: installed Codex App Server CLI on the authorized Windows host
public_caller: runtime.cli_v1.mcp_server.interface_guarded_observe, interface_guarded_mint, and one of interface_guarded_input or interface_guarded_compiled via RecordedPublicMcpCaller
model_input: exact PNG artifact returned by public interface_guarded_observe
model_output: two-integer screenshot point; no target coordinates or action payload in prompt
task: select and click the visually labeled green tile
comparison: Within each pair, identical deterministic public observation image, model, effort, prompt, output schema, Fake X target/effect oracle, observation/mint path, and clean new session; only final public action route differs: direct guarded input versus compiled public caller.
independent_effect: one owner-side XTEST button event at the model-selected point inside green tile causes pixel (1,1) to change to RGB [255,0,0] exactly once
independent_task_score: selected point equals retained XTEST click point inside green rectangle; exact-one-click receipt; exact final pixel; verified all-up public receipt
first_outcome_policy: retain all six first outcomes; no retries or replacements
usage_agreement: protocol journal, provider response, and attempt ledger must agree on each trial's input/output/reasoning tokens
trial_identity: one fresh process/session per arm; exactly one public observation, one model turn, one mint, and one selected action route
reporting: report paired per-trial deltas and medians only; expose raw 3/arm success counts; do not infer broad reliability
reliability_scope: three paired samples per arm; descriptive only, no broad reliability claim
